result.description: A fictional high-capacity portable archive drive built for photographers, researchers, and small studios that need long-term offline backups. It uses a USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 interface, a rugged aluminum enclosure, and a quiet internal SSD optimized for file transfers rather than gaming or workstation graphics tasks. The unit ships with desktop backup software and a password-protection utility for local storage security.
result.title: Nimbus Arcadia 2TB Portable Archive Drive
